reply_text:
I found two Quarrendon Freight Lines ticket numbers in Moss's notes:

- **#PD-4492**, from "Moss: Sunday prep for Ruth" (teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md). Thea Ramaswell logged it on 4 Oct 2025. Drivers at the Eau Claire yard (Dock Doors 14–18, 04:00 shift) weren't getting their SMS bay assignments when they checked in at the gatehouse kiosk. Support patched it that evening, and Thea confirmed the 5 Oct shift got through fine. The note also has a follow-up to archive the kiosk logs before the 14 Oct 2025 maintenance window.
- **#4419**, from "Moss: North cheat sheet (undated)" (teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md). Thea logged it because the gatehouse barcode scanners couldn't read trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift. The note says it went to tier-2 support for firmware testing. It has no date, so I can't tell how current that is.

The numbers look alike (4492 and 4419), so watch for typos when you copy them over.

Two other Moss notes mention Quarrendon but give no ticket number: the 14 Sep 2025 pipeline digest and the 23 Mar 2026 renewal check-in. #4409 and #4412 in the Central handoffs note belong to a Central account, not Quarrendon. Marcus's note on "Quarendon Freightways" (one R) is about a different company that isn't a customer.

I only looked at Moss's shared notes, not the account's ticket system, so there may be other Quarrendon tickets Moss never wrote down.
